Module ingsw.myshelfie
Package it.polimi.myshelfie.model

Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.myshelfie.model.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameModel, LobbyModel
public class Game extends Object implements GameModel, LobbyModel
Represents and entire game: it has all the settings, a name, the players, the living room, the common goals and the chat system.

    • drawTiles

      public void drawTiles(List<Position> positions, String playerName) throws InvalidParameterException
      Description copied from interface: GameModel
      Draws the tiles in the given positions from the livingRoom.
      Specified by:
      drawTiles in interface GameModel
      Parameters:
      positions - the positions of the tiles that have to be removed from the board, where the first in the list is the first one to be inserted into the player's bookshelf, and the last one is the last one to be inserted.
      playerName - the name of the player drawing the tiles.
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if the player is :
      • playing in the wrong turn
      • drawing and empty list of Position
      • drawing non valid positions
      • drawing more tiles then allowed
